title: UW Markdown Reserve Accounts Section
description: Content payload for the `reserve_accounts` section (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4.28, RFC 0064). The custodial roll-forward of one or more owner-restricted property reserve accounts by stated period: opening balance, dated movements (contribution in, draw out to fund a separately stated gross expenditure, release out to the owner) and the stated ending balance. This is a state-and-verify structure (RFC 0021 §6, the `cash_flow_series` precedent): the Tier-3 calc engine never reads it, and every stated ending balance is recomputed by `verifyReserveAccounts` over the Protocol §VIII.9.7 identity rather than trusted. The statement is evidence about cash custody, not a second expenditure ledger — a draw never nets against the gross TI/LC, capex or expense it funded — and a verified statement does not make an RFC 0045 reserve-dependent assembly plan eligible. This schema enforces structure only. The cross-field rules a validator adds are: real dates, finite nonnegative amounts and closed enums (RSV-01); `lender_reserve` reserved and refused (RSV-02); unique account identities and ordered, non-overlapping periods (RSV-03); movement dates inside their statement period (RSV-04); the balance identity at the currency quantum (RSV-05); consecutive-statement continuity (RSV-06); and a warning across a gap between statements (RSV-07).

_meta.description: Standard block provenance envelope (§2.5). Not constrained here.

label.description: Free-text name for the statement set (e.g. "Lender-required replacement reserve, monthly statements").

accounts.description: One entry per account. Identities are unique within the section (RSV-03).

account_id.description: Stable author-stated identity. Unique within the section (RSV-03).

class.description: Closed. `property_reserve` is owner-restricted property cash. `lender_reserve` is reserved for a later financing contract and is refused (RSV-02): a lender-held escrow is not property cash and cannot be verified as one.

purpose.description: What the account is for ("Replacement reserve", "TI/LC reserve").

currency_code.description: Optional uppercase three-letter currency identity, the RFC 0046 posture. Stated, never inferred from a symbol or locale.

statements.description: Ordered, non-overlapping periods (RSV-03). Consecutive statements (one starting the day after the prior ends) must agree on the balance they share (RSV-06); a gap is warned (RSV-07) and never filled.

period_start.description: ISO-8601 calendar date; the first day of the period. Must name a real day (RSV-01).

period_end.description: ISO-8601 calendar date; the last day of the period, inclusive. Not before `period_start` (RSV-03).

opening_balance.description: Cash held in the account at the start of the period.

movements.description: Every movement in the period, each added exactly once. May be empty: a quiet period is a real statement.

ending_balance.description: Cash held at the end of the period, as stated. Verified against `opening_balance + Σ contribution − Σ draw − Σ release` at the currency quantum (RSV-05); never derived.

kind.description: Closed. `contribution`: cash entering from outside the account. `draw`: cash leaving to fund a separately stated gross expenditure — the expenditure stays gross in its own section. `release`: cash leaving to the owner, separately from any gross sale. Anything else (interest credited, a fee, a transfer between accounts) is RSV-01, not the nearest kind.

amount.description: Nonnegative magnitude; the kind carries the direction.

date.description: ISO-8601 calendar date inside the statement period (RSV-04).
